purpose: Freeze what comparisons are required for a qualified learned PM, how each of the three external experiments contributes to the claim, and how generator capacity may be changed without outcome-driven model selection.

stage_gate_clarification.development_promotion: A small development slice does not require p<0.05. Positive grouped Quality direction, no directional material-risk increase or critical event, structural integrity, nondegenerate routing, and at least two independently verified source-aware Function cases are sufficient to justify one frozen confirmatory run.
stage_gate_clarification.formal_head_pass: Formal RS_pass or MS_pass still requires nonzero attributable reproducible Function, grouped same-stack Quality/Risk evidence, selector value beyond the named simple baseline, and marginal contribution controls.
stage_gate_clarification.functional_use_references: Single-component 0.80 and multi-component 0.70 are aspirational engineering references, not standalone hard head-pass predicates and not substitutes for attributable Function plus Quality/Risk evidence.

global_metric_margins.qa_margin_note: The QA margins must be bound before ES-MemEval outcomes are opened. If a disjoint development estimate is available, it may replace the proposed values once; otherwise these proposed values become final.

policy_qualification_is_conjunctive.machine_predicate: head_count_pass AND system_value_pass AND modeling_value_pass AND selection_value_pass AND oracle_safety_efficiency_pass AND external_evidence_pass

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: System value relative to no optional resource.
required_result: overall blind Quality NetWin cluster-95%-CI lower bound > -0.05
overall Quality NetWin point estimate >= 0
every prespecified material-risk learned-minus-baseline cluster-95%-CI upper bound <= +0.05
all severity-3 events disclosed and no critical event hidden by aggregation
on the frozen learned-ON slice, same-state randomized deployment-ITT component or policy uplift has a positive point estimate and is reported with a cluster interval
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: Optional-resource PM does not preserve the no-resource quality/risk floor; cost savings cannot rescue the claim.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Resource efficiency relative to enabling every structurally eligible component.
required_result: Quality and every material-risk proxy are noninferior under the same margins
mean actual generator input tokens are at least 10% lower
retrieval calls, retries, output tokens, latency, and USD are reported separately
shorter incomplete replies may not be used as the mechanism of the claimed input-cost saving
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: The router has not established a meaningful high-resource cost advantage at preserved response quality/risk.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Modeling value beyond a frozen auditable heuristic.
required_result: Quality, risk, and cost are Pareto-noninferior
at least one preregistered primary selection outcome is strictly better
the learned selector beats the named simple baseline under grouped/cross-fitted prediction evidence
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: A transparent rule is sufficient; no learned-PM advantage may be claimed.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Adaptive value beyond a static bundle at the same resource cost.
baseline_qualification_matrix.qualification: Absolute deterministic injected-cost mismatch <= 5% within preregistered outcome-blind broad strata.
required_result: at matched cost, learned PM is strictly better on Quality, verified Function, or material Risk
all remaining primary outcomes are noninferior
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: A static same-cost bundle explains the result; conditional routing value is not established.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Semantic state-to-action matching beyond using the same amount and frequency of resources at random.
qualification: component ON counts exactly match learned PM
at least 25% of states receive a different action
assignment uses no response, Quality, Risk, Function, judge, or external outcome
required_result: learned PM has strictly better cluster-level Quality or beneficial-ON/harmful-ON selection performance
material Risk remains noninferior
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: The result is explained by resource amount or ON rate rather than learned state-action matching.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Per-head marginal contribution and prevention of component free-riding.
required_result: every component counted as passed has nonzero reproducible source-aware verified Function
component-ON versus matched component-OFF has useful same-stack conditional behavior without material Quality/Risk regression
full learned versus full-minus-component shows a component-attributable contribution or a better quality-cost frontier
a failed or abstaining head remains OFF and cannot inherit another component's benefit
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: The component does not count toward RS plus two memory-head success.

baseline_qualification_matrix.proof_role: Joint-action correctness, safety, regret, and excess-cost assessment.
required_result: unsafe or structurally invalid selection rate = 0
deployment-ITT Quality regret is within the frozen 0.10 equivalence band
excess deterministic cost on the safe quality frontier <= 5%
oracle-set inclusion and beneficial-false-OFF/harmful-false-ON are better than transparent rule and matched random
baseline_qualification_matrix.failure_meaning: Independent component heads do not compose into a qualified joint 16-action policy.

head_pass_definition.selector: Nondegenerate grouped/cross-fitted signal that improves on the named simple baseline; both ON and OFF or abstention behavior must occur.
head_pass_definition.candidate_support: Real connected groups contain applicable and non-applicable or abstention support; candidate presence or retrieval coverage alone is not a pass.
head_pass_definition.verified_function: Source-aware offline review observes nonzero reproducible component-attributable contribution; generator self-report is insufficient.
head_pass_definition.same_stack_outcome: Against component-OFF and other frozen same-stack baselines, the learned component shows useful conditional deployment-ITT behavior without material Quality/Risk regression.
head_pass_definition.default_off_rule: Default OFF is the required safe behavior for a failed head, but it cannot satisfy selector, Function, or marginal-outcome evidence and therefore cannot create a head pass.

ESConv_response.proof_role: Single-session RS routing and immediate support; longitudinal memory is structurally unavailable.
required_pass: MP/MS/ME requested-ON count = 0
RS learned policy is nondegenerate
versus always-off: overall Quality/Risk noninferiority and positive learned-ON-slice paired uplift
versus fixed-high: Quality/Risk noninferiority and fewer RS injections; claim total input-cost reduction only if the 10% generator-input threshold passes
versus transparent rule: Pareto noninferiority plus at least one strict primary improvement
versus qualified matched random: better state-action selection at equal ON rate/cost and noninferior Risk
requested-to-received structurally = 1.00; source-aware RS Function is nonzero, attributable and reproducible; 0.80 remains an aspirational engineering reference
wrong-owner/future/scaffold exposure = 0

EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.proof_role: Joint RS plus longitudinal MP/MS/ME routing, typed evidence integration, grounding, interaction, and response cost.
required_pass: versus always-off: overall Quality/Risk noninferiority, nonnegative Quality point estimate, and positive frozen learned-ON-slice deployment-ITT uplift
versus fixed-high: Quality/Risk noninferiority and at least 10% lower mean generator input tokens
versus transparent rule: Pareto noninferiority plus strict learned-selection value
versus cost-matched fixed and cost/ON-rate-matched random: strict adaptive state-action value at matched resource amount
versus RS-only and learned-full-minus-component: each memory head counted as passed contributes verified Function or a better same-stack quality-cost frontier
RS_pass and at least two of MP/MS/ME individually satisfy the complete head-pass definition
requested-to-received per component = 1.00; source-aware component Function is nonzero, attributable and reproducible; 0.80 single and 0.70 multi remain aspirational engineering references
wrong-owner/future/scaffold exposure = 0
sixteen-action oracle safety, regret, and excess-cost gates pass
EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.evidence_boundary: EvoEmo state count is not user count. OOF predictions on labeled users are cross-fitted in-domain evidence, not untouched-owner external validation.

ES_MemEval_QA.proof_role: Memory retrieval, information extraction, temporal reasoning, conflict detection, user modeling, and abstention transport; not response Quality/Risk and RS is N/A.
required_pass: versus no-memory on answerable memory-required questions: Token F1 uplift cluster-95%-CI lower bound > 0

versus typed-memory-fixed-high: Token F1 noninferior within the final frozen margin, BERTScore direction consistent, conflict/abstention/false-answer outcomes noninferior, and input tokens at least 10% lower
versus official session-RAG Top4: objective QA and abstention/risk outcomes are Pareto-noninferior and at least one primary outcome strictly improves
versus full history: a preregistered accuracy-cost Pareto advantage; any accepted accuracy loss must stay within the frozen QA margin
information extraction, temporal reasoning, conflict detection, user modeling, and abstention are reported separately and no critical capability failure is averaged away
wrong-user/future/answer/evidence leakage = 0; should-abstain false-answer learned-minus-comparator upper bound <= +0.05
ES_MemEval_QA.llm_judge_role: Optional robustness diagnostic only; objective Token F1/BERTScore and deterministic retrieval metrics remain primary.
cannot_claim: independent new-user evidence beyond the shared 18-user longitudinal source

generator_factor_design.scientific_role: Generator is a treatment moderator and system component, not a response-policy baseline.
current_evidence: Current Llama-3.1-8B results conflate generator capacity with a restrictive RS treatment/compiler.
RS ON is compiled as the sole primary act while the dominant Restatement card forbids a question, advice, or second move.
A stronger instruction follower may reproduce the same incomplete reply more faithfully; changing generator alone is not an identified repair.
Warm-close under Llama partially improved Quality but more than doubled unsupported-personal-fact Risk, demonstrating a real treatment-by-generator interaction.

The MS-only ON-slice has a positive Quality point estimate, but 13/19 rows safely declined specific-memory use; this separates a promising prompt/program effect from still-open component-attributable memory Function.

deferred_robustness_factorial.timing: Only after the repaired invariant-R0 treatment passes the current-Llama development-promotion gate.
deferred_robustness_factorial.population: Fresh development states disjoint from external confirmation outcomes and from any generator-selection outcome panel.
interpretation: treatment improvement under both generators identifies a design/compiler limitation
improvement only under the stronger generator identifies a capacity or instruction-following interaction
no PM uplift despite stronger absolute replies means the PM/resource treatment still lacks value
positive PM uplift under both generators supports generator-robust routing

generator_selection_gate.timing: Deferred until current-Llama treatment repair passes development promotion, and still before any generator-robustness confirmatory outcomes are opened.
generator_selection_gate.selection_data: A dedicated development-only generator qualification panel.
generator_selection_gate.candidate_policy: Retain Llama-3.1-8B as the historical reference; qualify one stronger open-weight or open-API candidate and optionally one strong proprietary candidate, then freeze at most one stronger primary challenger.
required_checks: single-component source-aware Function is nonzero, attributable and reproducible; 0.80 is an aspirational reference
multi-component all-functional 0.70 is an aspirational reference rather than a standalone pass gate
current-turn grounding and explicit-safety handling pass
prompt, schema, seed schedule, token cap, retries, fallback, pricing, and endpoint identity are content-addressed
selection never reads external ESConv/EvoEmo/ES-MemEval outcomes

current_candidate_inventory_20260813.proprietary_capacity_probe: gpt-5.6-terra for quality/cost balance or gpt-5.6-sol for a frontier upper-bound probe; GPT-4o is not the current first-choice capacity probe.
current_candidate_inventory_20260813.selection_preference: Use one non-OpenAI generator as the primary challenger while GPT-5.6 remains a judge, reducing same-family generator/judge preference. GPT-5.6 may be a generator probe only with a non-OpenAI and/or human judge anchor.
current_candidate_inventory_20260813.freeze_rule: Resolve exact dated model ID, endpoint, price, transport, prompt, token cap and retry policy immediately before a paid development bakeoff; never use floating aliases in confirmatory runs.

formal_comparison_rule: Within each generator stratum, all policy baselines share the same generator and same semantic executor contract.
Cross-generator comparisons estimate generator main effect and PM-by-generator interaction; they do not replace within-generator PM baselines.
Different provider seed semantics are not assumed identical; use multiple preregistered replicates and cluster at dialogue/user, not seed.
A model-family-independent judge panel or human anchor is required to reduce generator-family self-preference.
Results from different generator-treatment hashes are never pooled as exchangeable outcomes.

claim_language.only_stronger_generator_passes: PM is qualified with the named stronger generator; Llama-3.1-8B is a negative capacity/executor boundary. No generator-agnostic claim.
claim_language.both_generators_pass: PM routing is robust across the two frozen generator strata.
claim_language.stronger_absolute_quality_but_no_pm_incr: The stronger generator improves replies, but PM conditional resource value is unsupported.
claim_language.generator_selected_after_external_result: Exploratory only; cannot support confirmatory Paper 1 claims.

required_next_actions: Treat the completed MS-only result as directional ON-slice development evidence, not as a formal MS head pass.
Bind this addendum and its human-readable companion into the active bundle.
Keep the corrected RS default-off record explicit that off-vs-off nonregression is not a passed same-stack component outcome.
Freeze a zero-API generator surface/cost/schema inventory before proposing any paid generator bakeoff.
Repair and qualify the RS treatment/compiler on fresh development states before any new external RS confirmation.
